name: E.A.S.E.
summary: Master education brand. E.A.S.E. Mental Math is its programme ("Think Faster. Calculate Smarter."). Clean, white-led, premium, credible for parents and schools, energetic for children without being childish.
fonts: Calibri (CSS: font-family: Calibri, Carlito, sans-serif). Bold for display/headlines, Semibold/Regular for support. No decorative, script or cartoon fonts.
hard_rules: Write the name as "E.A.S.E." and the programme as "E.A.S.E. Mental Math" — never "Ease Mental Maths" or "EASE Math Academy".
Never place "Mental Math" inside the logo artwork; set it as separate type beside/below the logo.
Mental Math communication stays in Navy / Teal / White (+ Charcoal text). Do not use every multicoloured tree colour in layouts. No day-specific accent colours.
Logo: never stretch, recolour, rotate, add shadows/glows/outlines, or put it on busy photography. Keep clear space at least the height of the capital E (~a third of the logo height) on all sides.
Default social format 1080x1350 (4:5) with a clearly reserved area for the E.A.S.E. logo and strong white space.
Sentence case for headings; ALL CAPS only for short labels such as MENTAL MATH.

Avoid: cartoonish visuals, floating numbers everywhere, 'genius child' imagery, rainbow overload, hype claims like 'make your child a maths genius'. Prefer measurable outcomes: speed, accuracy, concentration, confidence.
Geometric angular crops and subtle polygon motifs inspired by the E.A.S.E. tree are on-brand.

logos.note: Primary master logo (geometric tree + E.A.S.E. wordmark + descriptor). Transparent PNG, 1014x362 (aspect 2.8:1). Dark wordmark — use on white or very light backgrounds only. Recommended width 300–420px on a 1080px post.
